title: 愚公移山 · 分级读物 (HSK 1-3)
source_material: 愚公移山 (The Foolish Old Man Who Moved the Mountains) — classic fable from 列子·汤问, retold

outline.title: 门前的大山
outline.summary: Introduce a very old man named Yugong who lives beside a mountain. A huge mountain stands right in front of his home, so whenever the family wants to go anywhere they must walk a long, hard road around it. Everyone in the family is unhappy about the mountain.
outline.recap: An old man named Yugong lives with his family beside a huge mountain that stands right in front of their home, forcing them onto a long hard road whenever they go out; the whole family is unhappy and Yugong keeps looking at the mountain, thinking.

outline.title: 愚公的决定
outline.summary: Yugong gathers his family and announces his decision: they will move the mountain away so the road becomes easy. The family is surprised but agrees to help. The next day they begin, carrying stones away little by little.
outline.recap: Yugong gathers his family and proposes moving the whole mountain away; though they find it strange, they agree, and the next day they begin carrying stones far off, and even though the mountain looks unchanged after a day's work, Yugong is undismayed and vows to move a little every day.

outline.title: 很慢的工作
outline.summary: The work is painfully slow: the mountain is enormous and they are few, and carrying stones far away and walking back takes months for only a little progress. But Yugong and his sons and grandsons keep working every day without stopping.
outline.recap: The work is brutally slow — the mountain is huge and the family small, and a single trip to dump stones far away eats up much time — but Yugong reminds them the mountain cannot move itself while they can chip at it daily, so they labor from before dawn to after dark, and after months the stones have genuinely begun to dwindle.

outline.title: 老人的话
outline.summary: Another old man watches and laughs at Yugong: he is too old, the mountain too big, the task impossible. Yugong answers that he will die but his sons will continue, and their sons after them, while the mountain never grows — so one day it must be gone. The other old man has nothing to say.
outline.recap: A neighbor mocks Yugong as too old and the task as useless, but Yugong answers that even after he is gone his sons and their sons will continue endlessly while the mountain never grows, so it will surely shrink and be moved; the neighbor falls silent and Yugong keeps working.

outline.title: 山走了
outline.summary: Yugong's determination reaches the gods, who are moved that he will never give up. They carry the mountain away. The next morning the family wakes to find the mountain gone and the road flat and easy. The lesson: with enough effort, nothing is impossible to finish.
outline.recap: Moved by Yugong's tireless years of effort, the gods carry the mountain away overnight; the family wakes to find it gone and the way out now easy, and the story closes on its lesson — with steady effort, nothing is impossible to finish.
